cases.name: Susan Elizabeth Ramberg
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "She loved her family and friends more than anything. She loved her son, Eli, most of all, along with their dog, Scooter. She was fiercely loyal, and would do just about anything for her loved ones. Susan was kind, caring, empathetic, a devoted mother, sister, daughter and friend, a lover of animals, music and God, with a great sense of humor. But above all, she cared for the people in her life.

Susan was an amazing salesperson, who could sell pretty much anything to anyone. She spent many years developing her expertise in different areas of sales, getting to know many people, and making many friends along the way.

Susan greatly enjoyed traveling, when she got the opportunity, and visited Taiwan and Mexico, as well as many states across the US. She was an animal lover, and helped care for and adopt several cats and dogs throughout her life, rescuing many right off the streets. Susan’s faith was also deeply important to her."
cases.narrative: On 3/10/2023, during a welfare check, police found her body in the trunk of her vehicle in her garage. He allegedly killed her 3/2/2023 and left her 10-year-old son alone after her death.

cases.name: Tika Dhimal
cases.about: A neighbor said, "The wife would come over and help us garden in the backyard. They gave us pointers on how to make our vegetables grow. They brought marigolds over and put them in our garden."
cases.narrative: On 7/17/2024, police found them deceased after a 911 report of someone possibly dead in the backyard. He had hanged himself. Tika was found dead inside "from penetrating trauma" to her body.
